name: Botuthrax Clostidia, Great Unclean One

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Beloved of Nurgle
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 5 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Massive Bulk
bonuses.text: Botuthrax Clostidia is huge and immensely difficult to kill. It has 40 Wounds.

abilities.name: Pestilential presence
abilities.text: Anyone who sees Botuthrax must make a DN 5 Fear Test. Anyone not wearing a sealed suit must make a DN 7 Resolve Test or gain Poisoned (7) as their nerves burn.
Avalanche of Flesh: Botuthrax falls on its opponent.

abilities.name: Hideous Growth
abilities.text: Spend 2 Ruin. Botuthrax Clostidia regains 5 Wounds.

abilities.name: Pestilent Tide
abilities.text: Spend one Ruin. A wave of diseased flesh and acidic rotting matter spews from Botuthrax's guts. This is a ranged attack with the following profile: 12 +2 ED / AP -2 / Range 16 / Blast (4)

abilities.name: Crushing Bulk
abilities.text: Spend 2 Ruin. Botuthrax charges forward like a pestilential cannonball. Its target and any allies within 5m are crushed under its mass. Roll to hit once; compare the result against each Agent's Defence separately.

abilities.name: Nurglings!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. A single band of 20 Nurglings disgorge themselves from Botuthrax's guts and act immediately.

determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 10d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: A named Great Unclean One (not in the Core bestiary). Melee weapons print no range, as in Core: stored [1]. Hideous Growth, Pestilent Tide and Crushing Bulk are printed untyped under ACTION. Beloved of Nurgle is its Champion bonus (5 personal Ruin).
